caption: Follow for more simple toddler recipes that actually get eaten ✨ These easy sweet potato nuggets are perfect for snack time or a quick meal! Ingredients: • 1 large sweet potato  • 1/2 cup frozen peas  • Handful of shredded cheese  • Optional: garlic powder  Bake at 350°F for 35 minutes, flipping halfway through and adding a little more cheese on top when flipping 🤍 Let them cool before serving so they harden up a bit — perfect for little hands!
